notes: DREDGE v1, option A (strict separation). Splits are by database. test = all BIRD-dev and Spider-dev databases + 34 BIRD-train databases; dev = 8 and train = 27 BIRD-train databases. Spider-train databases are a test-only decoy pool and never a question source, so nothing a trained system sees can appear as a test decoy. The 200 pilot questions are kept inside test; test_quota counts include them. BIRD-train databases are dealt to splits stratified by table count. Steps 11-12: candidates are oversampled by `oversample`, evidence is built for all of them (build/03, build/04), and build/12 keeps the first quota of valid ones per origin in pick order; questions whose evidence exceeds max_replay_rows rows are dropped (feasibility of the sufficiency replay; the pilot maximum is 383,293).
